title: celeri graveolens
intro: Celeri graveolens, commonly known as wild celery, is a perennial plant in the parsley family (Apiaceae). It is traditionally used for its culinary and medicinal properties, boasting a range of health benefits including its ability to act as a diuretic, lower blood pressure, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of wild celery include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as apigenin, limonene, and sesquiterpenes. Additionally, the plant's essential oils have been found to exhibit antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties, contributing to its overall therapeutic value.
